head: 48e1006
observed_ceiling: six-prompt harness checks transport/runability but not semantic correctness
direct-Ollama burst evidence is route-orthogonal to HVM/xbreed
no reproduced HVM/xbreed burst lift at higher parallelism

flow: seal HEAD, model digest, manifest hash, host/runtime versions and idle snapshot
add validator-only benchmark metadata and prove it against recorded outputs
run one control end-to-end through direct Ollama, Bend/HVM, and xbreed routes
screen bounded request/runtime candidates against calibration
measure surviving candidates under HVM/xbreed bursts
run harness and configuration mutation tests
confirm Pareto survivors on untouched heldout cases
publish raw JSONL, summaries, provenance and explicit claim ceiling

protocol.note: 12 teammates may inspect/analyze concurrently; GPU-generating requests are capped at 8 active and excess burst requests queue client-side/server-side with bounded deadlines

sequence: verify model absent via /api/ps after explicit unload for cold observation
cold run once on each route in Latin-square order
warm run twice on each route in reverse order
capture wall, load, prompt-eval, eval durations, output bytes, exit status, model digest and cache before/after
pass: 9/9 route-state observations exit cleanly, exact and semantic validators pass, digest/config provenance complete, and no timeout/resource gate trips

checkpoints.action: seal provenance and resource baseline; reject dirty or mismatched runtime evidence

define validators for exact text/JSON, integer arithmetic, regex/schema, deterministic unit-testable code, refusal/safety, truncation and HVM sentinel stripping; test each with positive and adversarial fixtures
prove exact-json-01 across direct/HVM/xbreed and decompose route overhead

run at least four AB/BA blocks per survivor: cold/warm crossed with control/candidate, randomized prompt order and alternating candidate order; explicitly unload and verify cold, verify residency for warm

screen only bounded one-factor candidates: num_predict 32/64/128 versus 256 control, num_ctx 4096 only for long-context cases, and Ollama parallel 4 versus 8; preserve model/temp/seed/think/quantization
measure HVM and xbreed bursts at arrival widths 1,4,8,12 with max 8 active generations, two counterbalanced repeats per route/config, fixed prompt mix and per-request timeout
mutate validator expectations, output extraction, route label, cache-state label, timeout/error propagation, selected defaults and concurrency cap; require non-equivalent mutants killed
confirm survivors once on untouched heldout set, construct Pareto frontier, retain only non-dominated moves, and record rejected/uncertain claims

preflight: model digest and Ollama/HVM/Bend/xbreed versions recorded
GPU temperature/utilization settled before cold block
resource: abort on OOM, reset, sustained thrash or two consecutive timeouts
validity: validator fixtures all pass and adversarial fixtures fail
cold means model absent before request; warm means same digest resident
minimum four counterbalanced cold/warm blocks before latency inference
report median plus p90/p95 where sample size permits, completion rate and paired deltas; no significance claim from tiny n
quality: code cases pass sandboxed deterministic tests
no increase in truncation, sentinel leakage, empty output or false success
gates.pareto: retain a candidate only if it improves at least one named axis beyond run noise and harms none of hard semantic pass rate, completion rate, resource gates, or paired tail latency; otherwise reject or mark inconclusive

risks: explicit unload can measure reload rather than natural cold-start behavior
temperature zero does not guarantee cross-runtime determinism
12-wide arrival bursts queue behind parallel8 and must not be described as 12 active generations
xbreed orchestration overhead may dominate short prompts
num_predict reductions can look faster solely by truncating
small samples make tail and quality rankings unstable
shared CPU/RAM and thermal drift can invalidate blocks
semantic validators can overfit prompt wording
rejection_criteria: any provenance, route, cache-state or ordering field missing
candidate evaluated warm while control is cold or vice versa
semantic hard-pass regression of any size
completion below 100% in bounded calibration or heldout
p95/worst paired latency regression >10% without a quality gain
throughput gain caused by shorter/truncated output rather than equal completed work
result depends on only one order, one repetition or calibration prompts
claim of universal best, model-quality superiority, or p16+ lift without route-matched heldout evidence
